description: hashRace folds positions through Float32, still sensitive to 0.001
find: parts.push(p.kind, p.x, p.y, p.heading, p.vx, p.vy, p.lap, p.next, p.finished ? 1 : 0, p.finishTick ?? -1);
replace: parts.push(p.kind, Math.fround(p.x), Math.fround(p.y), Math.fround(p.heading), Math.fround(p.vx), Math.fround(p.vy), p.lap, p.next, p.finished ? 1 : 0, p.finishTick ?? -1);
